name: SBOM generation across build ecosystems
need: Maintainers and compliance-driven teams struggle to generate, sign, assemble and publish accurate SBOMs from their package managers and container builds to meet regulatory guidance.
reason: Nearly all statements ask to generate, sign or publish SBOMs for software.

name: Mixed CI scanning and Kubernetes config requests
need: A mix: a few teams want better secret detection in CI (dedup, fork PRs, regex rules), others ask about Kubernetes capabilities, cosign referrers, release checksums and offboarding.
reason: Only about four statements concern secret scanning; rest are unrelated requests.

name: Remediating vulnerable third-party dependencies
need: Developers and security engineers struggle to detect, prioritize and quickly update vulnerable direct and transitive dependencies, including faster patching despite release-age delays.
reason: Most statements concern finding and fixing vulnerable dependencies; two Kubernetes outliers.

name: SCIM user provisioning for applications
need: Admins of SaaS and self-hosted apps struggle with manual user provisioning and deprovisioning because products lack SCIM support for IdPs like Okta and Azure AD.
reason: Most statements request SCIM provisioning; few membership-management outliers.

name: Unrelated feature requests sharing GitHub boilerplate
need: A mix of access reviews, EKS IAM isolation, token revocation, OIDC tokens, SBOM builds, WebAuthn, SAML login, honeypot alerting and Terraform JSON support.
reason: Grouped by GitHub issue template text; needs are all different.

name: Assorted AWS networking and policy configuration
need: A mix: Kubernetes controllers on AWS/GCP need security-group, SCP, IAM-role and public-IP controls, plus multi-cloud CSPM, SIEM export and OSS Index exclusion questions.
reason: Cloud config requests to different tools with distinct asks.

name: Kubernetes pod security and SIEM mix
need: A mix: Helm/Kubernetes projects migrating to pod security standards and securityContext, alongside SIEM-for-Kubernetes questions, SIEM parsers and SCIM provisioning.
reason: Pod security forms a minority; SIEM and SCIM items unrelated.

name: IAM-based authentication in AWS service clients
need: Cloud teams moving off static passwords and keys find their clients and tools can't authenticate to RDS, MSK, Redshift, API Gateway or ArgoCD with short-lived AWS IAM credentials.
reason: Most statements ask clients to support IAM-signed short-lived authentication; few outliers.

name: Managing SIEM log noise and ingestion
need: Small security teams struggle to filter noisy logs, enrich and monitor log feeds, and turn SIEM alerts into processed actions without high cost.
reason: Most statements concern controlling and processing data flowing into a SIEM.

name: Assorted dependency scanner gaps and tooling
need: A mix: SCA/SBOM scanners missing lockfiles, architectures or distros, plus image package diffs, CI audit gates, IDE dependency views and env-file decryption.
reason: Scanning-related but distinct asks across different tools; one off-topic.

name: AWS role credentials for workloads
need: Engineers running workloads in EKS, Lambda or outside AWS struggle to get tools to use role-based, short-lived credentials via the default chain instead of static or expiring keys.
reason: Nearly all statements concern tools obtaining AWS role-based credentials properly.

name: CycloneDX SBOM output and attestation
need: Supply-chain teams want tools to emit and accept CycloneDX SBOMs (and VEX) and tie them to releases through attestations.
reason: All statements request CycloneDX SBOM support, VEX or attestation.

name: Network visibility questions for SIEM users
need: A mix: analysts ask how to detect Tor, attribute DHCP IPs, summarize pcaps or get router telemetry, plus a session audit logging request.
reason: Loosely network-related but each asks for a different capability.

name: Assorted access, reporting and inventory requests
need: A mix: SIEM login analysis, CSPM ingest feedback, user access reports, identity platform, AWS asset inventory, shared credential handoff and Azure provisioning.
reason: Grouped by generic words; needs span unrelated domains.

name: Dependency context for vulnerability impact
need: Teams analyzing SBOMs and advisories struggle to tell how a vulnerability affects their product because reports lack dependency hierarchy, parent component, container and vendor advisory context.
reason: Most statements seek dependency-graph or advisory context to judge vulnerability impact.

name: Mixed supply-chain hygiene findings
need: A mix: vulnerable transitive dependencies, replacing Snyk SAST, pinning Semgrep rules, isolating signing and unpinned Python builds.
reason: Different supply-chain issues; no single product addresses most.
